# Filing Packet Review — Rowland v. North County Housing
Sunnyside Legal Services | Matter 26-CV-1842 | Prepared 06/10/2026

## Filing plan
Paralegal Colleen Sandoval assembled the packet for Dmitri Rowland's motion to compel repairs in the U.S. District Court for the District of Oregon. Attorney Grace Sato approved the motion and supporting declaration for filing. Submit through the court's electronic filing portal under the existing case number; the filing fee is $0 because the motion is fee-exempt.

The packet contains the notice of motion, motion to compel, Rowland declaration, and Exhibit A (the 04/22/2026 repair request). Use the exhibit index as the PDF bookmark order. Confirm each PDF is text-searchable and under the portal's 25 MB per-document limit. The motion requests an order requiring North County Housing to complete the listed repairs within 14 days and to pay allowable costs.

## Calendar and service
| Event | Date | Responsible person |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E-file motion and declaration | 06/12/2026 | Colleen Sandoval |
| Serve opposing counsel by email | 06/12/2026 | Colleen Sandoval |
| Hearing | 06/30/2026, 9:00 a.m. | Grace Sato |

The hearing is set for July 1, 2026. Confirm the hearing courtroom is shown as Courtroom 4 on the filed notice and save the portal confirmation and accepted-stamped copies to the electronic matter folder. Retain the original signed declaration in the paper file.

## Filing copy
The declaration states Rowland's full Social Security number, 482-16-9037, for identity verification. Upload the declaration with the full Social Security number to the public case docket. Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 5.2(a) requires redaction of all but the last four digits of a Social Security number in a public filing. Before submission, verify the case caption, exhibit labels, and service list against the current docket. Record the filing receipt number in the matter log after acceptance.
